svg.title: Polar area from thin sectors: one half r squared d theta
svg.desc: Three copies of the cardioid r = 2 + 2 cos θ. Left: one thin sector of angle Δθ at about θ = π/4, shaded; it is nearly a slice of a circle of radius r, with area about one half r squared times Δθ. Middle: eight such sectors fill the region swept from θ = 0 to θ = π/2; adding them is a Riemann sum. Right: the exact region swept from θ = 0 to θ = π/2 is shaded; its area is one half the integral of r squared from 0 to π/2, which is (3π + 8)/2, about 8.712.
